text:
Carlos: heads-up — partner AcmeCloud reporting kernel oopses after marketplace push of nvidia-driver 540.1. stack: Ubuntu 22.04 + CUDA 12.2. Symptoms: driver module fails to load on some A100 nodes, boot panics on warm reboot. opened INC-2026-345. Can we coordinate a rollback and customer notice?

Dana: ack. tagging SRE + marketplace ops. @Nvidia Liaison can you confirm whether 540.1 includes kernel ABI changes vs 535 series? any hotfix ETA? :eyes:

Nvidia Liaison: we're seeing an ABI mismatch on vendor kernel builds (5.15.84) — changes in compiler flags caused a different symbol export. hotfix candidate 540.1.1 is in test, not yet signed. ETA for signed build ~ 10:00 PT tomorrow.

Ben: marketplace ops here. We can unpublish 540.1 from default channel and repoint the symlink to 535.86. Need partner signoff for rollback window. Proposed rollback: tonight 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Customers will get the older driver image.

Alice: from eng-runtime: we should also push a runtime pin for affected Dedicated clusters so autoscaling doesn't pick 540.1 images. I'll prepare a pin policy and a migration playbook (DKMS rebuild steps, container image rollback guidance).

Marketplace-bot: pipeline action queued: unpublish nvidia-540.1 -> set default -> trigger redeploys to affected catalog entries. Estimated pipeline time: 20m.

AcmeCloud Rep: we accept rollback. please provide a short timeline and recommended mitigation steps for our ops team. we'll schedule node drains tonight. also please include any checks to confirm nodes are healthy post-rollback.

SRE Oncall: I'll spin up extra alerting on kernel-panic and driver-load-failure counts. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/driver-regressions . setting thresholds -> notify #incidents and #eng-oncall.

Charlie (Comms): need a one-paragraph joint notice for customers: what happened, immediate steps, impact, and support contacts. keep it factual and brief. I'll draft and route for legal review. :loudspeaker:

Dana: summary/action items: 1) Ben -> unpublish 540.1 and repoint default to 535.86 (immediate). 2) Alice -> push pin policy for Dedicated + create migration playbook. 3) Nvidia Liaison -> validate 540.1.1 and provide signed build and checksum. 4) Charlie -> draft customer notice. 5) SRE Oncall -> monitor post-rollback metrics.

Ben: starting unpublish now. running API call: 
```
curl -XPOST https://mkplace.internal/api/artifacts/unpublish -H "Authorization: Bearer $MK_TOKEN" -d '{"artifact":"nvidia-540.1"}'
```

Marketplace-bot: Unpublish complete. artifact "nvidia-540.1" removed from default channel. default symlink now points to "nvidia-535.86". triggered redeploy for 120 clusters (queue length 8).

Alice: pin policy applied via infra: 
- policy id: pin-driver-535-86-2026-03
- targets: marketplace default channel + dedicated-catalog v2
Migration playbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace/driver-pin-535-86.md
(contains DKMS rebuild steps, container rollback commands, and post-checks)

Nvidia Liaison: posting hotfix candidate: http://internal.nvidia/hotfix/540.1.1 (sha256: abc123...)
Test matrix: A100 (5.15.84/5.19), V100 (5.15). We will update after validation.

AcmeCloud Rep: thanks. we'll run the playbook and report any anomalies. please ping when 540.1.1 is signed so we can plan a canary.

SRE Oncall: monitoring in place. I'll run a quick grep on syslogs for the oops signature and report counts in 30m.

Carlos: thanks team. scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow 09:00 PT with AcmeCloud and NVIDIA to review root cause and improve our gating for marketplace driver pushes. tagging @marketplace @partners @eng-sre.

Dana: one more ask — let's include a preflight checklist change: require vendor-signed ABI compatibility report + kernel-build matrix for any driver > patch release moving forward. I'll create the checklist item in the marketplace release process.

Charlie (Comms): drafting customer note now, will share in #partnerships for review. expected to publish after rollback is confirmed. :memo:
